analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see read has now held for 3 straight sessions. RSI is above 50 but below 60, staying in neutral territory. MACD histogram is improving in negative territory but no golden cross confirmed. Volume ratio of 0.29 indicates low conviction in current price action. Five consecutive daily gains suggest potential short-term overheating. At 93.4% of its 52-week high, upside appears limited. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
